CollectorProfile.title: Collector Profile
CollectorProfile.description: Authenticated collector account preferences, saved wishlist item IDs, and recently viewed craft IDs isolated per owner UID.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication user ID matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified account email address visible only to the document owner.

wishlistIds.description: Bounded list of saved product IDs (max 30).

recentProductIds.description: Bounded list of recently viewed product IDs (max 12).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update.

/users/{userId}.description: Private collector profile document strictly scoped to the authenticated owner (read/write owner-only, zero cross-user listing or shadow fields).
